title: Engineering Ligand and Receptor Pairs with LIPSTIC to Track Cell-Cell Interactions
author: Alberti, Guarniero, et al.
materials: pMP71 vector encoding GFP-P2A or Tomato-P2A coding sequences
Quantify concentration of the purified DNA.

steps.title: Add Overlap Sequences to Gene
steps.instruction: Append the 20‑bp overlap sequences to each LIPSTIC‑engineered coding sequence: 5′ end TGGAGGAGAACCCTGGACCG and 3′ end AATTCGAGCATCTTACCGCC. These overlaps are identical for both receiving vectors pMP71‑GFP‑P2A and pMP71‑Tomato‑P2A.

steps.title: Order Synthetic Genes with Overlaps
steps.instruction: Order synthetic genes that already contain the 5′ and 3′ overlap sequences specified in step 1. The authors routinely use Integrated DNA Technology (IDT), but any commercial synthetic‑gene provider may be used.

steps.title: PCR Amplify pMP71 Vector
steps.instruction: Amplify the pMP71 backbone using primers F1 and R1 (F1 anneals after the 3′ end of the insert site; R1 anneals at the 3′ end of the P2A sequence).

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µL PCR reaction: 1 ng template DNA, 1.5 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 2 µL 10 µM primer F1, 2 µL 10 µM primer R1, 10 µL 5× LongAmp® Taq buffer, 2 µL LongAmp® Taq DNA polymerase, add nuclease‑free water to 50 µL.
Run the thermal cycler: initial denaturation 94 °C for 30 s; 30 cycles of 94 °C 30 s, 55 °C 60 s, 65 °C 5 min 50 s; final extension 65 °C 10 min; hold at 4 °C (or 10 °C) until further use.

steps.title: Run Gel Electrophoresis and Purify PCR Product
steps.instruction: Separate the PCR amplicon on a 0.8 % TAE agarose gel, excise the band, and purify DNA using the GeneJET Gel Extraction Kit per the manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: Load the PCR product onto a 0.8 % TAE agarose gel and run electrophoresis.
Cut out the band corresponding to the expected size (6 262 bp for pMP71‑Tomato‑P2A; 6 335 bp for pMP71‑GFP‑P2A).
Purify the DNA with the GeneJET Gel Extraction Kit.

steps.title: Quantify Purified DNA Concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the purified vector DNA using an appropriate quantification method (e.g., spectrophotometer or fluorometer).

steps.title: Perform Gibson Assembly of Vector and Insert
steps.instruction: Assemble the vector and insert using Gibson assembly.

substeps.instruction: In a 20 µL reaction combine: 100 ng purified vector DNA (from step 4), insert DNA at a 3‑fold molar excess relative to the vector (from step 2), 10 µL Gibson Assembly Master Mix, and nuclease‑free water to 20 µL.
Incubate the mixture at 50 °C for 15 min.
Store the assembled product on ice or at –20 °C until downstream processing (step 7).

Optional: clone G5‑ and SrtA‑tagged molecules into receiving vectors that express different fluorescent reporters (e.g., GFP vs. Tomato) to facilitate identification of distinct cell populations in coculture experiments.
